title: Warm Roasted Canadian Pork Skillet
description: A hearty, roasted Canadian pork dish featuring lard and pickles, perfect for a solo dinner, made in a cast-iron skillet and gluten-free-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the pork shoulder with salt, black pepper, and dried thyme.
Heat the lard in a cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the pork shoulder until browned on all sides, about 2 minutes per side.
Remove the pork from the skillet and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the pickle juice to the skillet and stir to combine, scraping up any browned bits.
Return the pork to the skillet and transfer to the preheated oven.
Roast the pork in the oven for 20 minutes, or until cooked through.
Remove the skillet from the oven and stir in the chopped pickles.
